events.name: Los Angeles Rams at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: Jared Goff threw for 292 yards and three touchdowns and Todd Gurley ran for two TDs and caught another to help the Los Angeles Rams put up another big offensive performance with a 41-39 victory over the San Francisco 49ers on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rams use big offensive night to beat 49ers 41-39

headlines.description: The Jacksonville Jaguars are finally starting to feel at home at Wembley Stadium.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lewis scores 3 TDs as Jaguars rout Ravens in London

headlines.description: Tyrod Taylor threw two touchdowns and the Bills intercepted Trevor Siemian twice in the final 19 minutes of Buffalo's 26-16 victory over the Denver Broncos on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Buffalo Bills stymie Broncos in 26-16 win

headlines.description: Jordan Howard scored on a 19-yard run in overtime to lead the Chicago Bears to a 23-17 victory over the Pittsburgh Steelers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Howard's 19-yard TD in OT leads Bears over Steelers 23-17

headlines.description: Matthew Stafford's pass to Golden Tate was ruled to be just short of the goal line in the final seconds, overturning the call on the field and allowing the Atlanta Falcons to hold on for a 30-26 win over the Detroit Lions on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Falcons hold on to beat Lions 30-26 thanks to NFL rule

headlines.description: Jacoby Brissett ran for two touchdowns, threw for another and the Colts defense held off Cleveland's late charge Sunday to preserve a 31-28 victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brissett gets in sync to lead Colts past Browns 31-28

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Minnesota Vikings

headlines.description: Case Keenum gave Minnesota a brilliant performance in relief of Sam Bradford, passing for three touchdowns and a career-high 369 yards without a turnover to guide the Vikings to a 34-17 victory over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Keenum has 3 TD passes and Vikings top Buccaneers 34-17

events.name: Houston Texans at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Tom Brady connected with Brandin Cooks for a 25-yard touchdown pass with 23 seconds left, his fifth TD throw of the game, and the New England Patriots rallied to beat the Houston Texans 36-33 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brady wins another 1 in final seconds, 36-33 over Texans

events.name: Miami Dolphins at New York Jets

headlines.description: Josh McCown threw a 69-yard touchdown pass to Robby Anderson, Bilal Powell ran for a score and the New York Jets' defense dominated Jay Cutler and the Miami Dolphins in a 20-6 victory on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: McCown, defense lead Jets to dominant 20-6 victory

events.name: New York Giants at Philadelphia Eagles

headlines.description: Jake Elliott kicked a 61-yard field goal as the clock expired to lift the Philadelphia Eagles to a 27-24 victory over the New York Giants on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Elliott's 61-yard field goal lifts Eagles over Giants, 27-24

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: Drew Brees shredded the league's top-ranked defense, throwing for 220 yards and three touchdowns as the New Orleans Saints defeated the previously unbeaten Carolina Panthers 34-13 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brees throws 3 TDs, Saints dominate unbeaten Panthers 34-13

headlines.description: Marcus Mariota threw for 225 yards and two touchdowns, and the Tennessee Titans scored 21 straight points in rallying to beat the Seattle Seahawks 33-27 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Titans score 21 straight points in 3rd, beat Seahawks 33-27

events.name: Cincinnati Bengals at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: — Cincinnati Bengals running back Joe Mixon didn't practice Wednesday and is day to day with an ankle sprain.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bengals RB Mixon misses practice, status for Sunday unclear

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: Alex Smith threw two touchdown passes in the first 9 1/2 minutes, Terrance Mitchell had two interceptions and rookie Kareem Hunt scored on a 69-yard run to seal the Kansas City Chiefs' 24-10 victory over the Los Angeles Chargers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Smith, Chiefs start quick, beat Chargers 24-10 to go 3-0

headlines.description: Kirk Cousins threw for 365 yards and three touchdowns, Chris Thompson had 188 all-purpose yards and a score and the Washington Redskins sacked Derek Carr four times and held the Oakland Raiders to 128 yards in a dominating 27-10 victory on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Redskins put it all together in prime time to rout Raiders

headlines.description: Dak Prescott threw two touchdown passes and flipped head over heels into the end zone on a 10-yard run for another and the Dallas Cowboys pulled away in the fourth quarter to beat the Arizona Cardinals 28-17 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Prescott, Cowboys pull away to beat Cardinals 28-17
